name: Sunrise Manufacture Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunrise Manufacture Group Co., Ltd. is a multifaceted enterprise primarily focused on the global textile and apparel industry, operating across China, Vietnam, and Cambodia, with a significant international presence. The company's operations span various key segments, including Yarn, Fabric, and Garment production. Its extensive product range encompasses both knitted and woven fabrics, as well as finished garments and raw yarns. Notably, Sunrise Manufacture Group boasts a highly integrated supply chain, managing processes from cotton cultivation and spinning to dyeing, finishing, printing, embroidery, and ultimately, garment cutting and sewing. Beyond its core textile activities, the company has diversified into renewable energy, producing photovoltaic power. Established in Shengzhou, China, in 2007, the company adopted its current name, Sunrise Manufacture Group Co., Ltd., in September 2023, having previously operated as Zhejiang Sunrise Garment Group Co., Ltd.
